DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 126 s. 2021 01 December 2021 Mr. BAYAN' I-AGAC kayanilagac@yahoo.com.ph Dear Mr. Lagac: This has reference to your electronic letter dated 06 September 2021 seeking legal opinion from this Department on whether or not the appointment of the daughter of one of the members of Sanggunian Barangay as a Barangay Secretary by the Punong Barangay constitutes nepotism. At the outset, please be informed that this Department has made clear in its Legal Opinion No. 76 S. 20191 regarding appointments and nepotism on barangay level Nepotism has been defined by the Civil Service Law as bestowal of patronage by public officers in appointing others to position by reason of blood or marital relationships to the appointing authority.2 This prohibition has been reiterated in Section 79 Of R.A. NO. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code, viz: "Section 79. Limitation to Appointments. - No person shall be appointed in the career service of the local govemment if he is related within the fourth civil degree of consanguinity or affinity to the appointing or recommending authority." Nevertheless, it must be noted that the afore-quoted provision clearly states that it applies only to positions in the career service. Career Service3 is characterized by (1) entrance based on merit and fitness to be determined as far as practicable by competitive examination, or based on highly technical qualifications; (2) opportunity for advancement to higher career positions; and (3) security of tenure. On the other hand, Non-Career Service4 is characterized by (I) entrance on bases other than those of the usual tests of merit and fitness utilized for the career service; and (2) tenure which is limited to a period specified by law, or which is coterminous with that of the appointing authority or subject to his pleasure, or which is limited to the durations of particular project for which purpose employment was made.5 Further, Section 394 specifically provides: DILG Legal Opinion No. 76 S.2019, Noverntpr 14, 2019 DILG Legal Opinion No, 18, S. 2010 Section 7, Chapter 2, Title 1, 830k V Of Executive Order No. 292, the Administrative axle Of 1987 4 Sectim 8, Cha*er 2, Tide 1, V Of Executive Order No. 292, Or the Administrative Code Of 1987 s Supra Note 1 Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

"Section 394. Barangay Secretary: Appointment, Qualifications, Powers and Duties. - "(a) The barangay secretary shall be appointed by the punong barangay with the concurrence of the majority of all the sangguniang barangay members. The appqintment of the baranqav secretary shall not be subiect to attestation by the Civil Service Commission. (b) The barangay secretary shall be of legal age, a qualified voter and an actual resident of the barangay concemed. (c) No person shall be appointed barangay secretary if he is a sangqunianq baranqay member. a qovernment employee. or a relative of the punong barangay within the fourth civil deqree of consanguinity or affinity. X xxx x xxx x x x x" (Emphasis supplied) Foregoing considered, the Departrnent is of view that there is no nepotism in the herein case as the Barangay Secretary is a Non-Career Service position. Also, the punong barangay, who is the appointing authority, is not a relative of the appointed barangay secretary within the fourth civil degree of consanguinity or affinity. For as long as the above-quoted provisions of law have been properly complied and observed, the Punong Barangay did not violate anything, with respect to the appointment of the daughter of one of the members of Sanggunian Barangay as Barangay Secretary. The opinion of this Department is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated in your letter and our appreciation of the same. We hope to have addressed your concem accordingly. Thank you. Y yours, Y AUTHORITY OF THE SE B. DINO MA ETARY: ndersecretary for Barangay Affairs 2
